facts.fact: The document names ANSSI-CI as Côte d'Ivoire's national information systems security agency, working with ESATIC on two cybersecurity master's programmes from a workshop on 28 July 2026, and states it issues professional certifications.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI-CI)

note: Training programmes are not facts; only the body's existence is recorded.
